about_the_game:
*English Localization in Progress*

Our game does not currently support English, but we are working hard on localization before release. Please add the game to your wishlist to be notified when the English version becomes available at launch!

Turn-Based Combat & Choice-Driven RPG!

In this Choice-Driven RPG, players take on the role of mercenary Raya, who must fight for her destiny in a post-war world ruled by political factions pulling strings behind the scenes

Manage a mercenary company, employ various strategies to complete dangerous missions, and freely choose companions to build unique combat styles—or resolve conflicts through words instead.

In this last surviving city, Raya must confront both the conflicts among human factions and the looming threat of demonic invasion. Her fate is hers alone to decide.

Game Features：

  • Cunning strategies: Persuasion, investigation, intimidation, bribery, infiltration, cyber intelligence gathering—create situations that favor you. Or crush your enemies with brute force. Recruit allies and decide which factions to befriend or oppose. Your choices determine the survival of NPCs and entire factions.

  • Reputation system: Are you a greedy mercenary or a helpful one? Do you prefer overwhelming force or clever negotiation? Are you a workaholic or someone who seeks entertainment whenever possible? Your decisions shape how the world perceives you.

  • Fast-paced combat system: Harness magical powers from demons, combine them with companion abilities and equipment, and craft your own unique combat style.

Characters：

Raya：

Current head of the Halvard Mercenary Corps, known as “Raya the Hound”.

A mercenary and magic user who wields demonic powers by injecting demon blood.

With money forever on her mind, she’s quick to spot opportunities for easy gain.

  

Lili：

Raya's younger sister, and her assistant.

Handles administration and finance, often stuck working overtime.

 

 

Shiro：

A Demon Hunter skilled with many weapons, deadly against demons but awkward with people.

He sees demonic power as evil. So Raya, a magic user, was difficult for him to accept.

 

 
 

Morrison：

Captain of the Third Squad in the City Police Force, driven by a strong sense of justice.

He sees mercenaries as thugs for hire, so he takes every chance to confront Raya and her group.
